title: Report 02: who do AI engines cite for software pricing?
population: 40 answers: the query '[tool] pricing' for 20 business tools from our corpus, asked once to each of Chatgpt, Perplexity, US locale.
selection: The same 20 tools and the same query every month; one run per engine per tool.

headline.text: citations in AI answers about software prices pointed at the vendor's own site

limitations: One run per tool and engine per month: a pattern, not a precise rate.
Citations are not independent observations: one vendor site can account for many.
Correctness of the answers was not tested in this study.
'Not the vendor's own site' is not the same as independent.

corrections.what: Citations re-classified with the vendor's own domain from our database instead of matching the tool name inside the domain. This round was published on 2026-09-02 as 46% vendor citations; with the stricter rule it is 45%. 'Independent' became 'not the vendor's own site'.
